description: Crates a mainnet Solana program may depend on (directly or transitively) without an admin allowing each by name in its review: the pinned Anchor (0.32.1) and its Solana program crates, as the coding agents' template resolves them (CI checks the template's Cargo.lock is fully covered), plus a reviewed list. Exact names only: crates.io has no namespaces. Every crate must still come from crates.io with the checksum in Cargo.lock. Changes land only by a reviewed pull request.

never.anchor-spl: value-moving: token CPIs (the rug-pull rules refuse token programs on mainnet)
never.spl-token: value-moving: the SPL Token program's client
never.spl-associated-token-account: value-moving: the Associated Token program's client
